projectDescription: PrepFlow is an all-in-one warehouse management system for prep centers, covering inbound receiving, inventory tracking, pick & pack, Amazon FBA/FBM fulfillment, and client billing.
keyFeatures: Inbound order management with client dashboard visibility
Dock scanning and barcode-driven check-in workflow
Warehouse map with registered locations and barcode labels
Inventory tracking with real-time client visibility
Pick & pack sessions with location-sorted task routing
Amazon FBA integration with automated Seller Central sync
Amazon FBM integration with automatic shipment creation
Manual and Two-Step integrations for non-marketplace orders
Flexible billing system with per-unit, category, and storage pricing
Built-in shipping label purchasing with carrier rate comparison
Bundle system for multi-component product assembly
Optimized FBA shipment plan generation to reduce Amazon fees
publicApiSurface: Billing page (unit pricing, categories, boxes, services, storage)
Shipping Labels page (balance, upcharge, label purchase)
Warehouse Map setup and migration tool
Bundle inbound order creation and assembly
